provider.description: The identity provider to sign in with, on the first run, which writes it into the design system's src/config/auth.ts. Defaults to cognito. Later runs read the config: change the provider there, then run without this.

methods.description: How people sign in, on the first run, which writes them into the design system's src/config/auth.ts. Defaults to password, the only method so far. Later runs read the config: change the methods there, then run without this.

runtimeSpec.description: What to install @angular-capacitor-workspace/auth from instead of the range this release depends on, such as a file: path to a local build. Used by the integration matrix before a release is published.

apps.description: Applications to give sign-in screens. Defaults to every application except prerendered sites, whose pages are served to everyone.
